schema.description: An empty body generates a password for you.

Password.description:
The password to set. Omit it to have one generated.

It must meet your organization's password policy, which sets its length, the kinds of
characters it needs and whether it may appear in a known data breach. The default
policy requires at least 30 characters, including a number and a lowercase letter, not
found in a breach. The maximum is 64 characters.
